name: Fittest
description: Checks whether ML interatomic potentials can be trusted on a molecule. Three independent foundation potentials (MACE-MPA-0, AIMNet2, Orb-v3) evaluate an XYZ or {Z|symbols, R} structure; the server returns energies, forces, their force disagreement and a verdict: trust (with a Beta-posterior trust score and 90% interval) or send_to_dft. Trust scores are learned on gas-phase C/H/N/O Transition1x reaction chemistry (up to 7 heavy atoms); other systems are extrapolation. Non-periodic input only. Hackathon project (ScienceClaw 2026); usage is logged anonymously, structures are not stored.
